model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.15 r1 — Wage Pricing
notes: v7.7.15: finance layer, intermediate step (owner decisions 2026-10-12) — ore, energy and food prices follow the regional wage proportionally (declared labor shares), final metal and electronics demand responds to its price (elasticity 0.5); one wage_pricing node, model/nodes/wage_pricing.json, switch Wage Pricing Enabled. Full money accounting comes next. See docs/tasks/037-wage-pricing/.
Modes 0-53 keep Wage Pricing Enabled = 0 and reproduce v7.7.14 r1 exactly; Mode 54 = Mode 52 with wage pricing, Mode 55 = Mode 53 (transport surge with the labor market) with wage pricing.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
